milestone.title: M24.13 manual smoke checklist sign-off (HUMAN GATE)

intent.outcome: smoke-checklist.md is walked end-to-end on a real macOS machine by a human; the release blocker M24.13 is closed.

problem.description: M24 code steps (24.1-24.12) are complete, but 24.13 is a manual smoke gate that cannot be executed by an agent. Without human sign-off, the v0.2.0/rc1 release is blocked.

out_of_scope: Implementing features to make smoke pass

acceptance_criteria.description: smoke-checklist.md is signed off by a human; each item has a pass/fail annotation.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: git log --oneline -- smoke-checklist.md shows a commit by a human with 'Signed off' or equivalent

acceptance_criteria.description: If any smoke item failed, the related follow-up milestone is opened or the failure is recorded as a finding.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: any failure references an open mp milestone or mp reviews finding
